repositories.name: android_kernel_xiaomi_sm8250-5.15
repositories.completed: Ported alioth DT and Xiaomi peripherals, legacy ION/secure heaps 13/14/20, SPSS and vendor encryption interfaces; added UFDT, legacy-offset and retained-log diagnostics. Linux 5.15.206 and external modules compiled. Separate ThinLTO audit covered 207 modules and 18580 unique export providers without missing providers or CRC mismatches.
repositories.missing_or_unvalidated: 5.15 never booted recovery or Android. No useful Linux crash console was recovered. Board DT coverage, early-entry evidence and all vendor/hardware runtime behavior remain incomplete or unvalidated.
repositories.required_next_work: Locate the first Linux boot failure without UART, finish donor DT/binding translation, then validate storage, secure firmware, encryption, charging, graphics and peripheral probes. Triage Sparse and DT-schema findings before production hardening.

repositories.name: android_vendor_qcom_opensource_audio-kernel-legacy-5.15
repositories.completed: Imported attributed Xiaomi audio/codec changes and MIUS integration; adapted legacy compressed-audio component callbacks and native effect UAPI aliases for the 5.15 source module build.
repositories.missing_or_unvalidated: No working 5.15 audio runtime. DSP firmware compatibility, board routing, codec/amplifier probes, speaker output and MIUS behavior remain unvalidated.
repositories.required_next_work: After core boot, validate firmware and board routing, codec probes, PCM/offload/voice paths and amplifier behavior; complete any unsupported donor interfaces.

repositories.name: android_vendor_qcom_opensource_display-drivers-5.15
repositories.completed: Imported Xiaomi display changes, connected blank notifications to DSI lifecycle and adapted the alioth external 7 nm PLL. Fixed selected debugfs-disabled initialization and LLVM prototype issues.
repositories.missing_or_unvalidated: 5.15 recovery/system did not boot; panel/PLL probes, display output, refresh switching and Xiaomi panel features are not hardware validated.
repositories.required_next_work: Finish the native panel and power/clock binding integration, establish boot logs and test PLL lock, panel bring-up and refresh/touch behavior.

repositories.name: android_vendor_qcom_opensource_graphics-kernel-5.15
repositories.completed: Integrated release-pinned KGSL with the source build, corrected native DT register-range translation and selected the internal kernel API header explicitly. GPU/GMU DT work is in the core tree.
repositories.missing_or_unvalidated: GPU firmware initialization, IOMMU mappings, clocks and rendering are unvalidated because 5.15 did not boot.
repositories.required_next_work: Validate GPU/GMU resources and firmware on a booting core; exercise graphics allocation, rendering, fault reporting, suspend and recovery.

repositories.name: android_vendor_qcom_opensource_securemsm-kernel-5.15
repositories.completed: Integrated QSEECom/secure drivers and native headers; corrected shared-heap diagnostics/node references and preserved donor ICE copy/error behavior. Core-tree ports implement legacy heap and encryption bridges.
repositories.missing_or_unvalidated: SCM ownership transfer, protected-memory reclaim, SPSS/Keymaster interoperability and encrypted userdata mounting are unvalidated.
repositories.required_next_work: After early boot, verify secure firmware contracts, heap ownership, QSEE/SPSS services and encryption with real vendor userspace; retain failure propagation.

repositories.name: android_vendor_qcom_opensource_mm-drivers-5.15
repositories.completed: Published the release-pinned multimedia/helper tree with full ancestry and integrated the selected external-display module source into the matching build.
repositories.missing_or_unvalidated: Compile integration does not establish external-display/audio or multimedia hardware behavior; additional donor binding parity may be required.
repositories.required_next_work: Validate enabled helper probes and consumers after core boot; reconcile selected feature configuration with actual alioth hardware.

repositories.name: android_vendor_qcom_opensource_camera-kernel-5.15
repositories.completed: Published full-history release-pinned native camera sources and included the source driver group in the matching Android kernel/module build.
repositories.missing_or_unvalidated: The Xiaomi camera board port is incomplete. Sensor resources, regulators, context banks, IOMMU streams and old vendor HAL interoperability are not validated.
repositories.required_next_work: Translate donor camera topology and bindings for this driver, then validate firmware, probes, allocation/IOCTL contracts and each camera on a booting system.

repositories.name: android_vendor_qcom_opensource_wlan_platform-5.15

repositories.required_next_work: Reconcile alioth connectivity resources and firmware selection, then validate CNSS probes, firmware loading, recovery and suspend behavior.

repositories.name: android_device_xiaomi_alioth
repositories.completed: Integrated source-built core and nine external driver groups, Android Clang r563880c, matching module load/metadata placement, native UAPI export, UFDT image packaging and permissive development settings. A no-LTO Android 17 Evolution X OTA built and installed. Final development profile selects ThinLTO; ordinary builds default to maintained 4.19.
repositories.missing_or_unvalidated: Installed no-LTO 5.15 system did not boot. Separate ThinLTO validation is not a rebuilt/installed complete ROM. Full donor DT and vendor runtime compatibility remain incomplete.
repositories.required_next_work: Explicitly opt in to 5.15 only for development; use matched source-built images/modules, resolve early boot and validate recovery/system before production SELinux and complete hardware testing.

repositories.name: android_device_xiaomi_sm8250-common
repositories.completed: Added native UFS BSG permissions, native WALT tuning paths and USB-controller selection from boot arguments while retaining the legacy common-device base.
repositories.missing_or_unvalidated: Common boot/runtime behavior on 5.15 is unvalidated; changing init paths does not prove working USB or scheduler behavior.
repositories.required_next_work: Validate init/ueventd permissions, native USB naming, post-boot tuning and legacy vendor services after core boot.

repositories.name: android_hardware_qcom_bootctrl-5.15

repositories.required_next_work: Validate native BSG access, partition discovery, slot metadata and OTA boot-control behavior on a booting system.

repositories.name: android_vendor_qcom_opensource_video-driver-5.15

repositories.name: android_hardware_qcom_display-sm8250-5.15
